premise.claim: Every existing e2e suite installs the version under test from scratch, so none can catch an upgrade-only regression where helm upgrade disturbs already-running workloads.
premise.reportedComponent: CI / e2e coverage of the upgrade path
premise.patchedComponent: new suite test/e2e/upgrade + release-test.yml e2e-test-upgrade job
premise.evidence: Coverage premise, not a runtime symptom: the base branch (main @ 97fea1a) ships no upgrade-compatibility suite, and the two motivating regressions (#433 revision-serialization spurious rollout, #439 spurious-rollout/identity-labels) were both MERGED after being found by hand, not by CI. See results/premise.txt.

staticFindings.evidence: upgrade.go restartController (~268-271) calls waitControllerRolledOut + waitValidatingWebhookCABundle only; waitForUpgradeReady (142-148) calls all three incl. waitCRDConversionCABundle. Impact (stale conversion caBundle -> phase-4 v1alpha1 TLS error) not demonstrated; needs a live cluster. liveNote below.

install.go teardownFromRelease (~292-298) issues Delete per CRD with no wait-for-NotFound; helm uninstall --wait does not cover CRDs (chart does not own them), so cascading CRD deletion finishes after teardown returns.
specs.go phase-4 v1alpha1 pod-churn check (~679-683) compares against phase-1 `before`, not a local pre-annotation baseline like storedSpecDiff does with storedBefore.
install.go requireCleanCluster (~106-108) checks CRDs are registered, not leftover custom resources; narrow: requires a prior failed run whose CRDs were deleted while CRs hung on finalizers.
specs.go:282-288 mid-rollout partition check cannot distinguish 'partition removed by upgrade' from 'partition ignored'; the comment acknowledges the ambiguity.
snapshot.go checkStillReady (~1003-1026) iterates beforeSnap.ReadyByRole only; a role with no before status entry is never compared.

liveNote: L3 needs a real kind cluster with no rbgs install + published from/to images: `make test-e2e-upgrade`. Only signal worth adding for F2: after restartController in phase 3, read a v1alpha1 fixture through the conversion webhook and confirm no TLS error while the CRD conversion caBundle is still the pre-restart value. F3/F7 are observable via a back-to-back second `make test-e2e-upgrade` run hitting requireCleanCluster.
